notes: Redrawn samurai: every stance with new poses and animation
A new look for every oni and boss, including the forms of the Lord of Yomi
All ten worlds with richer ground, decor and ambient life
Boss altars awaken when you call the boss
Prompts now appear right over objects in the world
The run summary is no longer cut off on small screens
Achievements and the Sensei no longer speak over each other
The game fills the whole screen, edge to edge
